annotations.text: Premise: a Chat is List<AiBlock> — the thread IS container order. Two sides, one record: my move right in orange (the human's colour), the answer left with the column width code needs; no AI badge in a chat; the teal record shell materialises on hover. The card face with the badge survives as the NOTE-host rendering. Answers arrive WHOLE — blocks are the authoring grain (mint tools), not a display trick. Yellow pins = annotations; HOST/LENS tags say who owns the gesture.

Premise: a Workbench is a document WITH A SUBJECT (teal ⌖ chip, bare = re-read). Self-owned and remote are one design in two states — same bar, same annotations, same conversation panel. At this width the conversation sits BESIDE; narrow, it goes BEHIND and Mod+Enter flips.
The contract sheet: if a drawing here changes, it changes in chat, workbench and note together. Chip hue = rel. Pin = frozen, bare = live. Records keep full anatomy minus mutation.
